## TL;DR

The update dialog shows a "How to upgrade" block with the command for this install and a Copy button. The server returns `upgradeCommand` and `installKind` from `GET /api/release/available`, using the detection `repoos upgrade` uses. The old "Upgrade" button is relabelled "Release notes" and still links to the GitHub release. This session resumed a branch with the feature already implemented through review pass 4. The previous handoff failed at the Vite production build step. A scoped `REPOOS_CHECK_CHANGED=main repoos check` on the current tree passed with no failed steps. I did not find a cause for the earlier failure and could not reproduce it.

## Work and rationale

Review pass 4 reported the code as `good to go`, with two follow-ups: re-capture the shots on the final tree, and stop an empty `upgradeCommand` from showing "Copied". The shots are declared in the task as the light and dark `release:updateAvailable` fixtures on `release-upgrade-command`. The handoff captures them on the final tree.

I made the empty-command fix in `src/ui-app/src/components/ReleaseUpdateNotification.vue`. `copyCommand` now treats an empty command as a failed copy, so the button shows the failure message rather than "Copied" with nothing on the clipboard. The change is one line, and it is covered by the same scoped check run.

Pass 3 had found two things, and pass 4 confirmed both are fixed. First, a channel install compared against the latest stable release. `fetchAvailableRelease` now calls `fetchLatestRelease(install.channel)`, and `docs/releases.md` and `user-docs/getting-started.md` describe that. Second, the Copy button wrapped onto its own line. The fixed `flex: 1 1 100%` basis is gone.

## Approaches tried

I did not run the dialog in a browser this session. The shot captures are the visual evidence, and they run at handoff. Pass 4 reported that the earlier captures were on an older commit and showed the Copy button wrapped, which the later CSS change should fix. I have not checked the new captures.

## Challenges and blockers

The previous handoff failed at the Vite production build step. The queued message only showed the Vite start line, so I could not see the actual error. My scoped rerun of `repoos check` completed with exit 0 and "All checks passed". The build, rendered contrast audit, UI smoke test and user-docs build all passed. The test step ran on the remote validation runner, and that log shows 369 test files passing. If the Vite failure recurs at handoff, read that handoff log first.

Two things were not verified here:

- Acceptance criterion 4, remembering the dismissed banner version in localStorage, is not confirmed on this branch. If it is missing, it should go in a follow-up task.
- The branch diff against main is large because main moved after the branch started. Pass 4's merge-tree check reports a conflict only in the task's own `work/1073-*.md`, which close-out takes from main.

`cmdUpgrade` now prints the source-checkout message for any checkout, including one with a `.build-info.json` version. Before, it tried a standalone download into that checkout. The review flagged this as a CLI behaviour change beyond the dialog, so a human should confirm it.

## Key learnings

Computing the install kind on the server means the dialog shows exactly the command the CLI would run. A new install type then needs one change, not two.

The declared shots are only useful if they are captured after the last code change. Pass 4's captures went stale as soon as the CSS changed, so the final capture has to be the last step.
